title: Buffs - Mutation Buffs
blurb: Every mutation and what it really does, good and bad, straight from the game files. Find the best mutations for your build, compare up to three side by side, or open any mutation for its buffs, its downsides and when they work.

basics.title: Mutation basics
lines: Mutations last until you cure them (RadAway can remove them unless you have Starched Genes).
Class Freak (Luck) makes the bad effects smaller: rank 1 25%, rank 2 50%, rank 3 75%.
Strange In Numbers (Charisma) makes the good effects stronger while you are in a team with another mutated player.
Rad-X stops all your mutations, good and bad, while it lasts.
A serum gives you the mutation.

lines: Item: Adrenal Reaction Serum
Vendor: Purchasable from the MODUS Pharmacy in the Whitespring Bunker, or crafted at a Chemistry Station with the recipe.
Note: A serum grants the mutation with none of its negative effects for one hour.
Fresh: Take radiation damage and the game rolls a random mutation from the pool. Starched Genes prevents new mutations, so unequip it before farming rads.
Note: A mutation gained this way carries its negative effects unless you also hold a serum or the Class Freak perk.
